query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM users u
                WHERE u.is_admin
                  AND u.enabled
                  AND u.admin_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'sso'
                  AND u.password_hash IS NOT NULL
                  AND u.auth_source <> 'system'
                  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM system_clients sc WHERE sc.id = u.id)
            ) AS "exists!"
